adjudication_20260803.scope: RULING on new facts (flat YoY leverage, Q2 margin down YoY, 4.50x SPRINGING covenant w/ S&P leg pulled, unsourced hedge claim) - not a re-underwrite; verdict 6/10 STARTER stands
adjudication_20260803.load_bearing_leg_ruling: The court's actual load-bearing leg was the MARGIN-INDEPENDENT RE-RATER: deleveraging transfer (~10%/yr) + 5.5% cash div + BWGI EUR30 soft floor, with price/FV as overlay. The flat-ratio finding (2.6x->2.6x YoY; net debt -8.7% vs LTM EBITDA -9.1% EUR762->693M) does NOT kill the leg but RESTATES it: the EUR169M/yr debt paydown transfers value to equity ONLY IF EV holds, i.e. the leg is CONDITIONAL ON EBITDA STABILIZATION - a condition the record never stated. Evidence FOR stabilization: FY26 guide ~EUR700M vs LTM 693M confirmed, H1 margin +33bps floor held, FCF +54% ahead of plan. Evidence AGAINST: Q2 margin DOWN YoY (21.4% vs 22.5% - the H1 improvement was a non-repeating Q1 hedge-roll effect), France production negative 3 straight on the instrument. The Q3 volume bar (Oct-27) IS the stabilization test. THESIS SURVIVES 6/10, restated as conditional.
adjudication_20260803.springing_covenant_ruling: If Moody's cuts below Baa3 (one notch; negative outlook since Nov-25; S&P leg ALREADY pulled at BB+ Mar-13), the 4.50x semi-annual test ACTIVATES but is NOT BREACHED at 2.6x - EBITDA must fall ~43% (to ~EUR395M) before breach. Mechanically a NON-EVENT. Second-order financing-cost event only: (a) composite sub-IG reprices the 2028 refi wall (EUR200M TLB + EUR100.3M SLB) at HY spreads; (b) NEU CP (EUR237.9M outstanding) is ratings-sensitive but the EUR800M undrawn RCFs cover the CP stack >3x = liquidity non-event; (c) NO ratings-based margin grid in URD Note 17.6.1 (only the ESG +/-5bp ratchet). RULING: adopt thesis-doc bar 5 as a formal WATCH trigger, not a kill: Moody's below Baa3 -> covenant goes live -> REVIEW; escalate to court only if coincident with leverage >3.0x or CP rollover stress.

exit_band_20260806.classification: ALERTS + EXEMPTION (build-phase / TLH-core conflict) — explicit exemption per §6, deferred trim band armed on a size trigger

EXEMPTION_REASON.1_build_phase: The position is 370 shares (~EUR6,941 / ~$8,024) against a forward-base target of 1.0% = ~$60k / ~2,830 shares (SIZING_AMENDMENT_20260802) — it is roughly 13% built. TWO BUY legs rest live right now: rung 2 at 290 @ EUR17.20 GTC, and the 08-03 adjudicated at-spot add of 100 @ <=EUR18.25. A resting SELL above market while two BUYs rest below it, inside a verified EUR292M free float (12.26%), is a self-crossing build/trim conflict — and the sell would sit in the same thin book the buys are trying to fill from.
EXEMPTION_REASON.2_TLH_core_conflict: VRLA is tagged TLH_CORE_20260802 with an $80,000 target and Lots 2 and 3 (~$26,400 each) still unbought. The lot schedule exists to HARVEST LOSSES. Placing resting sells that can only ever fill at a GAIN is directly counter to the purpose of the tag, and realizing short-term gains at ~50% inside a tax-loss-harvesting vehicle is a straightforward own-goal.
EXEMPTION_REASON.3_no_wrong_side_exposure: The exemption does not leave the position naked: the kill set is fully instrumented (vrla_volume_watch weekly, graded call VRLA.PA|2026-10-27 frozen at 0.65), and the downside expression is alerts, which is what §6 mandates for kills anyway. What is being deferred is only the UPSIDE trim, and only until the position is large enough for a partial trim to mean anything.
